definitions.gloss: dialogue skills; ability to engage in productive conversation
definitions.explanation: The skill or capacity to communicate effectively through dialogue, including listening, responding thoughtfully, and building mutual understanding. Frequently discussed in education, business, and diplomacy.

examples.japanese: {対話力|たいわりょく}を{高|たか}めたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my dialogue skills.

examples.japanese: リーダーには{対話力|たいわりょく}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Dialogue skills are expected of leaders.

examples.japanese: この{研修|けんしゅう}では、{相手|あいて}の{意見|いけん}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す{対話力|たいわりょく}を{身|み}につけることを{目標|もくひょう}としている。
examples.english: This training aims to develop dialogue skills for drawing out the other person's opinions.

notes:
Composed of {対話|たいわ} (dialogue) + {力|りょく} (power/ability). Part of a productive pattern in Japanese where ～{力|りょく} creates nouns meaning "ability to do X." This word has become common in business and education contexts, especially in discussions about leadership and interpersonal skills.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対話力|たいわりょく}を{高|たか}める: to improve dialogue skills
- {対話力|たいわりょく}を{身|み}につける: to acquire dialogue skills
- {対話力|たいわりょく}が{問|と}われる: dialogue skills are put to the test
- {対話力|たいわりょく}のある{人|ひと}: a person with good communication skills

RELATED ～{力|りょく} COMPOUNDS:
- {会話力|かいわりょく}: conversational ability — broader, includes casual chat
- {傾聴力|けいちょうりょく}: active listening skills — the listening component of dialogue
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}: negotiation skills — more adversarial, goal-oriented
- {発信力|はっしんりょく}: ability to communicate outward — one-directional, unlike dialogue
